user.title: Automated Garden Watering — global settings
user.description: Set up your pump, backwash valve, and timing defaults. Both switches are optional — leave empty if you don't have that hardware.

data.backwash_interval: Automatic backwash interval — seconds of cumulative watering between automatic backwashes (0 = off)
data.backwash_threshold: End-of-queue backwash threshold — minimum seconds of total watering before an end-of-queue backwash runs

data_description.pump_switch: The Home Assistant switch entity that controls your well pump. Will be turned on before any valve opens.
data_description.backwash_switch: The Home Assistant switch entity for the backwash valve. If empty, all backwash behavior is disabled.
data_description.pump_pressure_delay: Time to wait after turning on the pump and before opening a valve. Runs once at the start of a queue.
data_description.backwash_pressure_delay: Time to build up pressure (pump on, valves closed) before the backwash starts.
data_description.backwash_runtime: Reverse-flow phase: the pump is turned OFF and the backwash valve opened, so water flows backwards through the filter and dislodges the dirt.
data_description.backwash_flush_runtime: Flush phase: the pump is turned back ON (backwash valve still open) to flush the dislodged dirt out.
data_description.backwash_interval: After this many seconds of cumulative watering, the controller pauses watering and runs a backwash, then resumes.
data_description.backwash_threshold: When a queue finishes, run a final backwash if at least this much watering happened (or if the queue was started by the timer).

zone.title: Add an irrigation zone
zone.description: Add one zone. After saving, you can add more.

data.name: Display name
data.order: Run order for 'Water all' (lower runs first)

data_description.name: Friendly name shown in the dashboard.
data_description.entity_id: The Home Assistant switch entity that opens this zone's valve.
data_description.duration: Default time this zone runs. Effective time = duration × global multiplier.
data_description.order: Smaller numbers run earlier. Use gaps (10, 20, 30…) to make later reordering easier.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure global settings
reconfigure.description: Change which pump / backwash switches the integration drives, or adjust the timing defaults. Zones are managed under the 'Configure' menu.

abort.already_configured: Automated Garden Watering is already configured. Use 'Configure' on the existing entry to change settings.

missing_switch.title: Missing switch for {name}
missing_switch.description: The switch entity `{entity}` configured for the {name} no longer exists in Home Assistant. The matching automated-garden-watering entity will stay unavailable until you point it at a valid switch via *Settings → Devices & Services → Automated Garden Watering → Reconfigure* (for pump/backwash) or *Configure → Zones* (for zone valves).

init.title: Automated Garden Watering
init.description: Edit global settings or manage zones.

data_description.pump_switch: Switch turned on before any valve opens.
data_description.backwash_switch: Backwash valve switch. Leave empty to disable backwash.
data_description.pump_pressure_delay: Wait this long after the pump comes on before opening a valve.
data_description.backwash_pressure_delay: Build up pressure (pump on, valves closed) for this long before the backwash starts.
data_description.backwash_runtime: Reverse-flow phase: pump OFF, backwash valve open — water flows backwards and dislodges the dirt.
data_description.backwash_flush_runtime: Flush phase: pump back ON, backwash valve still open — flushes the dislodged dirt out.
data_description.backwash_interval: Run a backwash automatically after this much cumulative watering. 0 disables it.
data_description.backwash_threshold: Final backwash runs only if at least this much watering happened (or if the queue was timer-started).

zones_list.title: Zones
zones_list.description: Pick a zone to edit, or add a new one. To reorder, edit a zone and change its 'Run order' number. To remove a zone, open it and tick 'Delete this zone'.

data.name: Display name
data.order: Run order for 'Water all' (lower runs first)

data_description.name: Friendly name shown in the dashboard.
data_description.entity_id: Home Assistant switch entity for this zone's valve.
data_description.duration: Default seconds; effective time = duration × multiplier.
data_description.delete_zone: Tick this and press Submit to permanently remove this zone. Leave unticked to save your edits.

water_all.name: Water all
water_all.description: Run every configured zone in run order. Calling this while a queue is active stops the queue (emergency stop).

stop.name: Stop
stop.description: Stop the current queue and close all valves. No-op when nothing is running.

backwash.name: Backwash
backwash.description: Trigger an immediate two-stage backwash (reverse flow followed by flush). Fails if no backwash valve is configured.

water_zone.name: Water zone
water_zone.description: Queue (or dequeue) a single zone by display name, zone id, or valve entity id.

zone.name: Zone
zone.description: Zone display name (case-insensitive), zone id, or the valve's switch entity_id.

not_loaded.message: Automated Garden Watering is not set up. Add the integration before calling its actions.

no_backwash_configured.message: No backwash valve is configured for Automated Garden Watering.

zone_required.message: A zone name, id, or entity_id is required.

zone_not_found.message: No zone matched '{zone}'. Provide its display name, id, or the valve switch entity_id.
